objects.title: A blast radius is a prediction made from lineage. Lineage cannot say whether the numbers actually moved, so a change to a mart must also be compared against ...

extensions.statement: A blast radius is a prediction made from lineage. Lineage cannot say whether the numbers actually moved, so a change to a mart must also be compared against a built baseline before it lands — otherwise "safe" means "nothing downstream references it", not "nothing downstream changed".

objects.title: pf tool recce run for change-verified-against-baseline

extensions.statement: A value-level diff writes the rows it compared into the review tool's state file, which is durable and shared. Diffing a column whose role is PII therefore persists real addresses into an artefact that gets committed and passed around — the same failure `pii-not-in-consumption` prevents in the warehouse, one layer further out.
